rules.last_session: PROVISIONAL: touched threads and standalone beats with narrative_impact and lasting_consequence both medium or high; story order; no cap
rules.want: serves_thread is null (an end, not a means) and significance is not incidental (Goals: parent_goal_id null, significance not incidental)
rules.owe: definite_end; commitment_type is not general_agreement; stake, burden and consequence are not trivial (Obligations filter)
rules.blocked_by: active, persists beyond the scene, not covered by immediate danger, and blocks a thread holding a shown want, debt or opening
rules.could_use: helps_thread names a thread whose want or debt is shown, directly or through a parent thread (Opportunities and New Assets need a goal link); role is direct (Opportunities: parent_opportunity_id null); an opening needs action_supported yes; a pointer is hidden only when a selected home fact has the same resource_subject, form, helped thread, full text and uncertainty; an asset with low or trivial goal_support is shown only if acquired by acting on an opening (New Assets filter)
rules.unknown: question_type open_ended and all four dimensions medium or high (Mysteries filter)
rules.threat: harm_origin is not party and no evaluation is low (Brewing Troubles filter); not covered by an immediate danger
rules.all: never possibly moot facts; no caps

last_session_candidates.change: The party arrived at Brandonsford following a treasure map whose marked locations they did not recognize.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The opening beat sets up the party's motivating goal of finding the treasure via an unfamiliar map.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The map's unknown locations and treasure remain the party's reason for being here and will drive later exploration.

last_session_candidates.change: Reginald warned the party that a trickster Clurichen comes into town from the riverbanks every night.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: A single warning introduces a new nightly danger but nothing has happened with it yet.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The creature is said to come nightly, and Sir Phidipaldi already invoked Clurichens, so it is likely to come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned a black dragon troubles Brandonsford and Eric the Reeve offered 1000 gold to whoever kills it and brings back its body.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Eric's 1000-gold offer, George's lost arm, and Farmer Gill's account of the old dragon and his hunting sons establish a major foe and a new main goal.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The dragon still lives with a large bounty and rival hunters in the field, so it will shape later Sessions.

last_session_candidates.change: Lady Hilda offered to join the party against the dragon for pay, and Sir Phidipaldi said they would return to hire her.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: A seasoned potential ally made an offer and the party signalled intent to accept, but no deal is struck.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Sir Phidipaldi promised to come back for her services, so the hire is likely to come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: Drop Dead Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold a week, and Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: A dangerous potential hireling made a concrete offer that remains undecided.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Dr. Uriah is still considering the offer, so Ned is likely to reappear.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned no shipments have reached Brandonsford in months, starving the town of goods, for an unknown reason.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Bentley's and Gill's accounts reveal a town-wide supply problem, a significant discovery tied to the dragon.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The unexplained cause is an open mystery likely to be investigated later.

last_session_candidates.change: Sir Phidipaldi insulted Eric the Reeve and challenged him to a duel at dawn, and Bentley sent him to the Golden Egg for the night.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The glove slap and duel challenge soured relations with the bounty-giver and got Sir Phidipaldi expelled from the tavern.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The dawn duel is unresolved and the quarrel with the Reeve who holds the bounty will likely carry into the next Session.

last_session_candidates.change: Farmer Gill offered Dunk his mule Shamus for 100 gold, and Dunk is sleeping in Gill's barn to consider trading work instead.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: An offer of an ordinary mount was made and not yet accepted.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Dunk is sleeping on the offer, so it will probably be settled soon but is minor.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned Warwick the smith displays a superb mithril chain shirt that he refuses to sell.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: A single beat reveals a coveted item that is out of reach.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: It may tempt the party later, but nothing has been set in motion.

last_session_candidates.change: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to stage a fake ale delivery for Quinn for 100 gold to get back at Bentley.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: An agreement was made for paid work, while Quinn's account of nightly vanishing stock adds a mystery.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The staged delivery has not yet happened and is likely to play out in a later Session.
